notes.en:
## New Features

- Add a native per-turn timeline panel showing model requests, tool execution, approval waits, compaction and nested subagent lanes, with segment details, zoom and follow-latest controls on desktop and mobile.
- Add outline plan locking and pending changes: people can lock a plan, review agent proposals, and confirm or reject changes while progress updates and notes remain writable.
- Inject outline-backed task and behavior-boundary views only when their content changes, preserve them across compaction, and migrate existing behavior rules into the session outline.
- Add a default-disabled speech backend for multi-protocol transcription and synthesis, including OpenAI Audio, MiMo/Qwen Chat ASR, MiMo Chat TTS and Qwen DashScope TTS. This release provides backend APIs only, without speech UI or automatic read-aloud.

## Improvements

- Keep timeline reads in bounded, paginated worker queries, draw only visible segments, and back off live refresh to reduce main-thread and rendering load.
- Persist reply context across runtime recovery and stabilize conversation identity, workspace serialization and cached-prefix boundaries.
- Replace lifecycle status polling with shared WebSocket invalidation notifications.
- Auto-detect executor installation platforms and apply updated server addresses when generating installation commands.

## Fixes

- Avoid repeating plan-mode reminders after every tool call.
- Show TLS certificate SANs and refresh built-in certificates at startup when their covered addresses change.
- Initialize inherited reply context only after resource admission succeeds, and strengthen prefix snapshot queue deadline coverage.
- Initialize the Drizzle migration ledger in PostgreSQL test fixtures before applying migrations.

## Upgrade Notes

- This version is published to the beta / prerelease channel and continues to use executor-v0.9.5 and helpers-v1.0.0.
- Database migrations are included. Back up your database before upgrading.
- Outline task and behavior views apply to outline-backed sessions; existing spec-backed sessions retain their task backend. Speech support remains disabled until explicitly configured.
notes.zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 新增原生会话时间线面板，按轮次展示模型请求、工具执行、审批等待、上下文压缩及嵌套子代理泳道，支持片段详情、缩放与跟随最新，兼容桌面和移动端。
- 大纲新增计划锁定与待确认改动：用户可锁定计划，审阅并确认或拒绝 Agent 的修改提议；进度更新和笔记仍可直接写入。
- 大纲任务与行为边界视图仅在内容变化时更新上下文，压缩后仍保留，并将已有行为规则导入会话大纲。
- 新增默认关闭的多协议语音转写与合成后端，支持 OpenAI Audio、MiMo/Qwen Chat ASR、MiMo Chat TTS 与 Qwen DashScope TTS。本次仅提供后端 API，不含语音界面或自动朗读。

## 改进

- 时间线改用有界、分页的 worker 查询，仅绘制可见片段，并根据请求耗时降低实时刷新频率，减少主线程与渲染负载。
- 持久化回复上下文以支持运行恢复，稳定会话身份、工作区序列化与缓存前缀边界。
- 生命周期状态改用共享 WebSocket 失效通知，替代轮询。
- executor 安装命令自动识别目标平台，并使用更新后的服务器地址。

## 修复

- 避免每次工具调用后重复注入计划模式提醒。
- 展示 TLS 证书 SAN 地址，并在内置证书覆盖的地址变化时于启动阶段自动更新证书。
- 仅在资源准入通过后初始化继承的回复上下文，补强前缀快照队列执行期限的验证。
- PostgreSQL 测试夹具在执行迁移前初始化 Drizzle 迁移账本，修复迁移测试兼容性。

## 升级说明

- 本版本发布到 beta / prerelease 通道，继续依赖 executor-v0.9.5 与 helpers-v1.0.0。
- 本次包含数据库迁移，升级前请备份数据库。
- 大纲任务与行为边界视图对大纲后端会话生效；已有 spec 后端会话保留原任务后端。语音功能需显式配置后才会启用。
